title: Repository policy
description: A file under policies/ (design v3 §1.2, §6.2). Repository-wide rules about what no task may change, and where a change must be backed by test evidence, whatever the task was asked to do. This is not scope: scope is per-task, and a task that declares none is unrestricted by it.
$comment: A policy that protects nothing and requires nothing is one nobody will notice is broken.

require_tests.description: Paths where a changed Go function or method must be reached by at least one test that then passes. Reach comes from the code graph and from the candidate's own tests in the same package.

path.description: A glob against a repository-relative path. `a/**` covers a whole subtree.

reason.description: Why this matters. The operator reads it at the gate, so it should say what would go wrong rather than restate the path. A rule that cannot say why it exists is one nobody can judge.
